quote: "sweetened by an outrageous amount of ca. 3% of ethyl maltol"

quote: "counterbalanced by an even more extreme amount of ethyl maltol"

quote: "count on this oriental being a fruity, syrupy experience"

quote: "a huge dose of some vile woody-amber material"

quote: "the kind that smells like rubbing alcohol played at heavy metal concert volume"

quote: "The huge chocolate-mothballs-cucumber accord of Black Orchid was a clever idea"

quote: "the inclusion of an iris note"

quote: "one in the heart (some sort of gourmand accord)"

quote: "declaring his love for Iso E Super ( 1.45 , ca . 35%)"

quote: "5% of Texas cedarwood oil in the Jean‐Claude Ellena 's woody milestone"
